"_i" in variable name indicates an integer less than 5, identifying peers, any operation done on this kind of
variable is done on each element of a vector containing every peers' version of that value.
Boomlet's niso_0_event_block_height is updated with freshly received value in each message containing it.
Each message is represented by a name composed of stage||sender||receiver||# in which # represents the #th
message from sender to receiver in that stage.
In withdrawal diagrams, peer_0 denotes the initiator role in the expanded example and peer_1 denotes one
non-initiator role; these are not fixed active setup peer indexes.
Each entity inside user-side box of each peer_i is represented by entityName_i.
Some steps between initiator and non-initiator run asynchronously and concurrently, these steps when
associated with non-initiator are denoted by an 'n' character at the end of step#.

Regardless of whether a new duress procedure ran, Boomlet freshly encrypts
duress_placeholder_plaintext for SAR. Counter advancement is evaluated before updating last_seen_block and
occurs only if the local chain view advanced and every other peer's prev_ping_i.last_seen_block is within the
accepted boundary around the current local Niso height. Independently of counter advancement, every otherwise
valid Pong then moves last_seen_block toward niso_0_event_block_height by at most the configured jump. It
records monotonic reached flags, sets its own reached_mystery_flag once counter reaches mystery, and sends a
of the PING_PONG_LOOP. if the loop breaks WT sends its reached_pings_collection to all Peers.
Niso receives reached_pings_collection from WT. It verifies that the
collection contains exactly one current reached ping from every active peer, in active setup peer order, with
expected approved_withdrawal_id, current ping sequence, fresh last_seen_block, and reached_mystery_flag set.
Only after those checks does Niso hydrate the PSBT without changing the transaction semantics or tx_id, then
sends reached_pings_collection and hydrated_psbt to Boomlet.
